# `m.stocks.filings.index`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The index of SEC EDGAR filings by US-listed companies, one row per filing and filer.

```python
m.stocks.filings.index(symbols=None, *, form_type=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

[All datasets](README.md)

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Verbs | `fetch()`, `poll()` |
| Served by | REST |
| Time range | `start` and `end` are sent as `filing_date.gte` and `filing_date.lte` |
| `poll()` | `dm.PollMode.APPEND`: appends only rows it has not seen, keyed by `Cik` and `AccessionNumber` |
| `sort` | any REST field of the rows (see Massive fields below), or several separated by commas, each with an optional `.asc` or `.desc` |
| `filters` | `cik`, `cik_any_of`, `cik_gt`, `cik_gte`, `cik_lt`, `cik_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte` |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "Stock ticker symbol for the filing entity, if available." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | SEC accession number uniquely identifying the filing (e.g., '0000320193-24-000123'). | REST |
| `Cik` | String | SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity. | REST |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). | REST |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the filing on the SEC EDGAR website. | REST |
| `FormType` | String | SEC form type (e.g., '10-K', '10-Q', '8-K', 'S-1', '4', etc.). | REST |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the company or entity that submitted the filing. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
